exposure: Body mass index (BMI) categorized using revised consensus guidelines for Asian Indians and WHO criteria
cohort: Pregnant women who gave birth between January 2010 and December 2012 at a tertiary care institute in India
finding: The use of revised BMI categories for Asian Indians led to a larger classification of high-risk pregnant women and was associated with adverse maternal and fetal outcomes.
mod_finding: Obesity, classified by both Indian and WHO guidelines, was significantly associated with cesarean sections.
